name: Karmi
title: Descendant of Reuben
summary: Karmi was a son of Reuben, Jacob's firstborn son. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. Karmi is mentioned in several genealogies in the Old Testament as one of the founders of a clan within the tribe of Reuben.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Reuben
keyEvents.description: Karmi was born as one of four sons of Reuben, Jacob's firstborn son with Leah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Reuben in Exodus 2
keyEvents.description: Karmi is listed among the sons of Reuben in the genealogy that records the sons of Israel and their descendants in Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Karmi was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine in Canaan, when Jacob was reunited with Joseph.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Karmi is listed in the detailed genealogy of the tribe of Reuben in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Reuben in the census
keyEvents.description: Karmi's descendants, the Karmites, were counted among the tribe of Reuben during the census in the wilderness.
